summary: Victims deposited funds into the Bitora trading platform which displayed fake profits and blocked withdrawals while funds were routed to operator-controlled accounts; the operation repeatedly changed domains after shutdowns and collected identity documents through fake verification processes
user_mistake: deposited funds into an unverified trading platform based on platform claims and advertised profits
prevention: Verify regulatory status through official regulator databases before depositing funds/Perform a withdrawal test before committing larger amounts
